headline: Approved handicap parking, speed humps, a street closure, and bus stop parking changes on several streets.
summary: The Traffic Commission accepted the February 17, 2026 minutes and approved several new requests, including a handicap parking space, speed humps on three streets, a one-day street closure for a festival, and parking rule changes near removed bus stops on Lebanon and Salem Streets. Many older items remained tabled, including speed humps on Pearl Street, resident parking on Seaview Ave, and a stop sign at Highland Ave and Clifton St.
decisions: Approved a handicap parking space at 57 North Milton Street, with the sign to be placed in front of 58 North Milton Street, by unanimous voice vote.
Approved installing speed humps on Beachview Ave, Elwell St, and Oliver Ave by unanimous voice vote.
Approved closing Maplewood Street on May 16 (rain date May 17) from Noon to 6:00 p.m. for the Maplewood Festival by unanimous voice vote.
Approved the proposed parking regulation changes for Lebanon Street and Salem Street related to removed bus stops by unanimous voice vote.

The monthly meeting of the Malden Traffic Commission  was held  on Tuesday, March 
17, 202 6, at 5:00 p.m. in Conference Room #1 08 at City Hall.

NEW BUSINESS:
Accept minutes of the February 17, 2026 meeting.
A motion was made by Chief Steven Froio, seconded by Mr. Dick Barricelli and 
unanimously voice voted to accept the minutes of February 17, 2026 meeting.
HANDICAPPED PARKING:
Dinora Lemus Ulloa 57 North Milton Street
After discussing this request and based on the recommendation of Lt. Tuxbury a 
motion was made by Chief Stev en Froio seconded by Mr. Dick Barricelli, and 
unanimously voice voted to approve.   Please note that the 57 North Milton 
handicap sign will have to go in fro nt of 58 North Milton as there is No Parking  
on the odd side of that street.
Speed Humps Stephen Winslow, Counc Ward 6
Beachview, Elwell and Olive Ave
Requests the Traffic Commission approve installing “Speed Humps ” on Beachview 
Ave, Elwell St and Oliver Ave.
After a lengthy discussion and based on information provided  by Mr. Stephen 
Winslow a motion was made by Mr. Dick Baricelli seconded by Mr. Charles Ioven, 
and unanimously voice voted to approve.
Maplewood Festival Stephen Winslow, Counc Ward 6
Street Closure
Requests the Traffic Commission approve the closure  of Maplewood Street  on May 
16 (rain date – May 17) from Noon to 6:00 p.m. for the annual Maplewood Festival.
After discussing this request and based on the information provide by Mr. Stephen
Winslow Councilor Ward 6, a motion was made by  Chief Steven Froio seconded by Mr.
Dick Baricelli and unanimously voice voted to approve.
Lebanon and Salem Street Ernie Ardolino, Parking
Bus Stop Removal Changes
Requests the Traffic Commission approve the following prop osals for Lebanon 
Street and Salem Street w hen these bus stops are removed:
(1) Amend current regulation on East side of Lebanon Street that has “2 Hour 
Parking, 7am-6pm, from Salem Street to Hartshorn Ave ” change to “2 Hour 
Parking 7am-7pm from 65ft North of Salem Street to Hartshorn Ave.
(2) Propose new regulation, East side of Lebanon Street “15 minutes, 7am-7pm 
from 45 ft North of Salem Street continuing for 20 feet ” (2 spaces).
(3) Amend current regulation on North side of Salem Street that has “2 Hour 
Parking 7am-6pm from 60 ft West of Laurel to 100 ft West ”.  Change to “2 
Hour Parking 7am-7pm from Laurel Street to 325 West ”.
(4) Propose new regulation, North side of Salem Street “15 minutes 7am-7pm 
from 325 West of Laurel St continuing for 25 ft ” (2 spaces).
(5) Amend current regulation on South Side of Salem Street that has “2 Hour 
Parking 7am-6pm from 20 ft from Maplewood St to 100 ft East ”.  Change to 
“2 Hour Parking 7am-7pm from 85 ft East of Maplewood St to Myrtle St ”.
(6) Propose new regulation, South side of Salem Street “15 minutes 7am-7pm 
from 60 f t East of Maplewood St continuing for 25 ft ” (2 spaces).
After discussing all of these requests with information provided by both 
Councilor Stephen Winslow and Mr. Jim Tarr, Traffic Planner a motion was made by 
Mr. Charles Ioven, and seconded by Chief Steven Froio, and unanimously voice 
voted to approve.
